correctness.rationale: Exact greedy block count B follows from forced 1→0 transitions and shareable 0→1 transitions. Every deletion changes B by 0 or 1; the exhaustive run, endpoint and merged-singleton cases give precisely the language criterion. Geometric run enumerators yield the three rational generating functions. Standalone exhaustive subsequence enumeration confirmed 55 parameter triples, 693 MAS and 683530 candidate checks, without being used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete forbidden-basis classification for a canonical periodic binary family. It supplies an effective membership criterion and uniform exact cardinalities for every parameter, identifies a sharp three-way growth transition and shows saturation under longer constituent runs. It can benchmark minimal-absent-subsequence enumeration and describes a full infinite class, not a cherry-picked finite table.
